text:
maria-ops: config-sentry reported repeated HelmRelease churn for 'model-serving' in prod — chart version flipping between v2.3.0 and v2.3.1 over last 2h. Anyone actively touching infra-configs?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: alert: helm-sync: model-serving prod/ -> chartVersion mismatch (v2.3.1 <-> v2.3.0) — 3 reconciles in 1h. https://deployments.redwood.local/alerts/8231

jon-enginfra: saw this. Looks like Flux/Argo is reapplying because a sealedsecret got re-encrypted, which changes metadata/annotations and flows into the HelmRelease valuesHash. Helm controller thinks values changed and re-install triggers.

sasha-sre: is this the sealed-secrets rotation experiment we rolled out last week? we moved to daily re-encrypt to test key-rotation behavior.

maria-ops: yes — sealed-secret re-encryption produces new annotation timestamps + controller adds checksum annotation. Those annotations are being included in the values that calculate HelmRelease diff.

kevin-ml-infra: this explains the GPU pod churn we saw around 02:14 and 03:07 — pods restarted during reconciles, caused batch jobs on GPU nodes to preempt. quick estimate: ~8% cost bump yesterday due to pod restarts and rescheduling.

jon-enginfra: short term options: 1) make Flux ignore specific metadata paths in the compare (ignorePaths), 2) patch HelmRelease to compute valuesHash excluding sealedsecret annotations, or 3) stop sealed-secret daily re-encrypt (bad for security). Need to weigh ops vs compliance.

sasha-sre: don't want to disable rotation. Suggest we add a narrow ignore rule: ignore sealedsecrets.bitnami.com annotations and fields that are purely proof-of-rotation, keep everything else strict. Also add a guard that triggers paged alert if reconcile rate > 5/hr for a given HelmRelease.

maria-ops: I'll open a PR to infra-configs with a kustomize/flux patch and a GH action that runs kube-diff in staging as a pre-merge check. That should stop accidental churn from reaching prod.

jon-enginfra: include a small unit check in the PR: helm template both chart versions and run a diff on values.yaml to prove the only diffs are sealedsecret annotations. Example: `helm template ./chart --values prod-values.yaml | yq e 'del(.metadata.annotations.sealedsecrets\.bitnami\.com.*)' - | diff -u - <(helm template ./chart --values prev-values.yaml | yq e 'del(.metadata.annotations.sealedsecrets\.bitnami\.com.*)' -)`

maria-ops: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/infra-configs/pull/412 — includes kustomize patch for ignorePaths and a GHA job `kube-diff.yml` that runs helm/flux dry-run against staging. Running dry-run now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: dry-run: applied kustomize patch in staging (dry). No restarts observed in staging after patch. Prod rollouts will happen during next maintenance window once PR is merged.

sasha-sre: SGTM. After merge: schedule a one-time reconciler for prod to stabilize rollouts, then monitor GPU node utilization + autoscaler behaviour for 2h. Tagging @oncall.

oncall: oncall: i'll watch the window, adding a temporary autoscaler buffer +1 to prod-gpu-nodepool to absorb possible restarts. Will escalate if reconcile rate spikes again. :thumbsup:

maria-ops: for visibility, attaching the small kustomize snippet we're proposing:

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
patchesJson6902:
- target:
    group: apps
    version: v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: flux-helm-controller
  patch: |-
    - op: add
      path: /spec/values/ignorePaths
      value: ["metadata.annotations.sealedsecrets.bitnami.com/*"]
```

and the GH Action (kube-diff) snippet: 

```yaml
name: kube-diff
on: pull_request
jobs:
  diff:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Run helm template diff
        run: |
          helm repo add stable https://charts.redwood.ai && helm dependency update ./charts/model-serving
          ./scripts/kube-diff.sh --staging --helm-chart charts/model-serving --exclude-annotations 'sealedsecrets.bitnami.com'
```

maria-ops: after we merge, I'll also update ops runbook with the temporary mitigation and a note on how to revert if compliance requires reverting rotation.

kevin-ml-infra: thanks — this should remove noisy reconciles and save some GPU cost. Once stable, we can analyze the 24h workload to see if we can lower autoscaler buffer.

jon-enginfra: agree. also let's add a periodic job that detects 'helm churn hotspots' (helmrelease reconcile count > X over 24h) and surfaces them in infra Slack channel automatically.

maria-ops: opened follow-up issue for churn detector: https://github.com/redwood/infra-ops/issues/276

sasha-sre: nice. closing loop: PR linked, dry-run ok in staging, oncall watching prod window. Will post post-mortem if anything unexpected pops up. :white_check_mark:
